description: Local market depth of one LSOA or MSOA from HM Land Registry Price Paid (standard category A sales only): sales in the last 12 months, turnover (% of EPC-linked homes that sold), the leasehold share OF SALES (not of homes), new-build and resale median GBP/m2 over 36 months with the new-build premium (each median needs 10 sales, the premium both), and the LSOA's GBP/m2 growth. Aggregates only: never a valuation, a listing or addresses.
